failing_rubric_items.reason: PRD_AC_GAP. Phase 1's Implementation Phases row Description and Success Signal assign the behaviour 'the repo names the library it will use with the reason recorded', but the source PRD's ## Acceptance Criteria (test scenarios) section (AC-1..AC-10) defines no criterion for it. The plan has no local move: omitting AC-A4 fails R-COH-AC-TASK-DECOUPLED because Task 4 would deliver behaviour no AC enforces, and citing an unrelated PRD AC-N fails R8b. Re-authoring the plan cannot fix this.

passing_note: All other R1-R8 items and every R-COH-* deterministic check pass. R-COH-VALIDATE-ALWAYS-PASS verified line by line: every VALIDATE declares its precondition and exits non-zero on failure. No task requires the autonomous implementer to deploy, push to production, reach production over the network, or configure the machine; the device pass is explicitly excluded from every task and Level 3 stops at a local `wrangler dev --local` 401 check. The K=5 coherence pass returned zero findings.
blocked_on: owner decision — amending an APPROVED, owner-validated PRD's Acceptance Criteria is not a mutation any agent in this pipeline may make unilaterally (interactivity boundary). The 2026-08-29 decision in docs/decisions.md sanctions ADDING a row to an APPROVED PRD's phase table under a dated amendment note, and explicitly leaves editing existing rows out of bounds; adding an acceptance criterion is an adjacent case that decision does not cover.
manual_recovery_paths: Add the missing acceptance criterion to PRPs/prds/push-channel-proven.prd.md under a dated amendment note, then re-run /relay-execute — it resumes at phase 1 with the plan still DRAFT.
Decide instead that recording the library verdict needs no acceptance criterion, and have the plan annotate Task 4 as documentation/infrastructure the way Tasks 3 and 5 are annotated.

resolved.how: Owner chose to amend the PRD: AC-11 added under a dated amendment note. Plan review resumed and reached APPROVED on the fourth attempt.
resolved.note: This file is retained as audit history. It does not reflect current state and gates nothing on resume.
